plan_metadata.title: Policy Accuracy and Demo Hardening Implementation Plan

objective.summary: Correct the four known materially misleading policy behaviours, harden SQLite persistence, preserve useful failed-extraction diagnostics, clarify analyst-facing state, and add provider telemetry without changing or rewriting historical take-home-v3 policies or results.
success_state: take-home-v3 remains byte-for-byte unchanged and all existing v3 snapshots remain readable
corrected policies are provisioned as a separate take-home-v4 rulebook
new runs can explicitly select take-home-v4 while old runs retain take-home-v3
SQLite connections enforce declared foreign keys and tolerate bounded UI concurrency
failed attempts expose bounded secret-safe diagnostics without admitting partial facts
the UI distinguishes machine workflow state, analyst state, live execution, cached results, and failed attempts
provider latency, model identity, token usage, and cost availability are persisted without storing credentials or raw evidence

known_worktree_exceptions.rule: Do not stage, overwrite, restore, or reconcile until Phase 2 produces a logical database diff and receives a separate approval.
Do not delete or commit until its contents, provenance, and retention value are audited.

non_negotiable_invariants: Never update persisted v3 policy selections, fact resolutions, evaluations, recommendations, review packages, or analyst decisions.
Never infer a negative fact from NOT_FOUND.
Never partially admit an invalid provider response.
Never persist API keys, authorization headers, raw provider responses, prompts containing evidence, or unbounded evidence-derived error text.
Keep Gradio as a presentation layer; policy, extraction, evaluation, and recommendation logic remain in application/domain services.
Every new mutable aggregate remains immutable and append-only after insertion.
Live-provider tests and live demo runs remain explicitly gated and are not part of ordinary pytest execution.

included: a new executable take-home-v4 rulebook with all eight policy keys and targeted corrections for Visa 13.3, Mastercard 4855, Mastercard 4859, and Visa 10.5
a policy-aware recommendation mapping manifest version 2
additive database migrations for safe failure diagnostics and model request telemetry
database backup, integrity verification, and recovery documentation
analyst state and attempt-history clarity in the existing UI
provider latency, token, model, and optional cost telemetry
unit, integration, end-to-end, UI, and migration regression tests
excluded: rewriting historical results using corrected policies
automatically rerunning historical failed or completed cases
a new frontend framework or Gradio redesign
distributed workers or a message queue
automatic cost estimates without an exact versioned pricing record

approval_gates.required_before: Any code, policy, database, fixture, or UI change.

approval_gates.decision: Approve the source-derived take-home-v4 semantics for Visa 13.3 comparison branches and return-route alternatives.
approval_gates.failure_action: Keep take-home-v4 unavailable and continue using caveated take-home-v3.

approval_gates.decision: Approve the proposed disposition of the modified fixture baseline and untracked live-validation database after read-only logical audits.
approval_gates.required_before: Any restore, relocation, commit, or deletion of either database.

approval_gates.decision: Approve promotion of take-home-v4 as a selectable demo rulebook.
approval_gates.failure_action: Leave the application default and demo database on take-home-v3.

approval_gates.decision: Approve changing the application default rulebook from take-home-v3 to take-home-v4.
approval_gates.failure_action: Require an explicit --rulebook-version take-home-v4 option for corrected runs.

implementation_sequence.name: Reconfirm and protect the baseline

changes.action: Run git status, record the branch and HEAD, and verify the committed live-results database checksum.
changes.writes: A timestamped audit report under docs/checkpoints only; no database write.

changes.action: Run the complete non-live test suite before implementation.
changes.continue_condition: All baseline tests pass, or every pre-existing failure is documented and approved.

changes.action: Record SHA-256 hashes for every file under data/rulebooks/take-home-v3 and add an immutability regression test using a checked-in manifest.
Open data/demo-validation.db read-only and record schema, table counts, integrity_check, foreign_key_check, and content checksum.
changes.rule: Do not vacuum, checkpoint, migrate, or change journal mode on the historical database.

definition_of_done: Baseline tests pass.
The v3 hash manifest is reproducible.
The committed live database checksum still equals 953842e9b43731e1635fd81d36f2aee6f4f6ca6cd756efa65c79101e870e74fc.
No historical file has changed.

implementation_sequence.name: Create a corrected additive take-home-v4 policy lane
implementation_sequence.principle: All corrections are source-derived, scheme-agnostic at runtime, and isolated from v3.
shared_requirements: Copy the source PDF and canonical transcript by content, retain their source hash, and create a new rulebook metadata record; do not link v4 policies to mutable v3 rows.
Provision all eight policy keys so catalogue coverage remains 10 of 10 cases.
Policies not named in the four corrections may be semantically equivalent to v3, but must receive new v4 policy IDs, hashes, citations, and snapshots.
Validate every required fact against the v4 fact catalogue.
Validate every exact quote against canonical transcript lines.
Reject duplicate version + scheme + reason-code keys.
Keep take-home-v3 as the application default through this phase.

policy_corrections.current_defect: The v3 predicate compares the reported delivery address with billing postcode only, so a billing mismatch can produce NOT_SATISFIED even when the frozen shipping postcode matches delivery.
policy_corrections.three_valued_rule: If the delivery address or both cardholder addresses are unavailable, return UNKNOWN. A mismatch against one known address does not defeat a match against the other.
acceptance: LS9 8AA delivery versus LS9 8AA shipping is TRUE even when billing is LS1 4DT.
A match to billing only can also be TRUE.
No known delivery address is UNKNOWN, never FALSE.
No case ID appears in the predicate interpreter.

policy_corrections.current_defect: The exact NO-SHOW evidence value is not recognized and the late-cancellation route has no deterministic comparison against the merchant's cancellation window.

new_predicate_operator.name: HOURS_BETWEEN_LESS_THAN
new_predicate_operator.true_when: Both datetimes are timezone-aware, later >= earlier, the numeric maximum is non-negative, and elapsed hours are strictly less than the maximum.
new_predicate_operator.unknown_when: Any input is NOT_FOUND, AMBIGUOUS, CONFLICTING, timezone-naive, invalid, or chronologically reversed.
new_predicate_operator.false_when: All inputs are valid and elapsed hours are greater than or equal to the maximum.

acceptance: An exact NO-SHOW value makes the first branch TRUE without requiring cancellation facts.
A cancellation 10 hours before service with a 24-hour window makes the second branch TRUE.
A cancellation 24 or more hours before service makes the second branch FALSE.
Missing cancellation evidence is UNKNOWN and cannot prove no cancellation.
Date-only evidence is not silently promoted to a datetime.

policy_corrections.current_defect: The global mapping treats an unestablished exception as insufficient evidence, but Visa 10.5 requires the merchant to accept liability unless the miscoding exception is affirmatively established.

mapping_manifest.selection_rule: First match by exact rulebook_version and policy_id; then use the global aggregate fallback. Reject zero matches and multiple matches.

policy_corrections.three_valued_rule: The evaluator still returns UNKNOWN for NOT_FOUND. The policy-specific recommendation mapping, not the predicate interpreter, applies the source-defined default disposition.
acceptance: Affirmatively established miscoding recommends represent.
Unestablished or disproven miscoding recommends do not represent.
The mapping snapshot, version, and hash are frozen in RecommendationResult.
Other policies continue through explicit global fallback rules.

current_defects: V13.3-R2 treats photos, specifications, visible damage, and serial evidence as universally cumulative.
Absence of a recorded return-request date can be misread as proof that no request occurred.
NOT_FOUND visible damage must not be presented as defect-free merchandise.

r2_corrected_structure.explicit_exclusion: image_observed_visible_damage is not a product-match predicate and is not used to prove absence of a hidden or structural defect.
r2_corrected_structure.source_semantics_gate: G1 must confirm that either source-cited branch is independently sufficient. If the source does not establish branch sufficiency, V13.3-R2 remains NOT_ESTABLISHED and take-home-v4 is not promoted.

acceptance: Visible armchair and sage-green observations remain model observations with image provenance.
A photo cannot establish absence of a hidden structural defect.
NOT_FOUND visible damage produces no negative conclusion.
The return route and post-complaint-use route are alternatives.
A missing return-request date cannot satisfy the no-request branch.
The no-request branch requires an affirmative, scoped merchant-record assertion with count zero.
No conclusion-style fact such as product_matches_listing is introduced.

code_changes.change: Add validated, declarative FACT_EQUALS_FACT, FACT_SET_INTERSECTS, and HOURS_BETWEEN_LESS_THAN nodes. Reject incompatible fact types during policy import.
Implement the new operators with explicit TRUE, FALSE, and UNKNOWN semantics and shared NFKC/trim/casefold normalization only.
Add recommendation mapping manifest schema version 2 with exact policy conditions, deterministic ordering, and overlap validation.
Select and hash the exact versioned mapping manifest; fail closed on no match, multiple matches, lineage mismatch, or hash mismatch.
Validate new predicate nodes, fact types, exact citations, complete catalogue coverage, and rulebook identity.

tests: tests/test_take_home_v4_policy_semantics.py
tests/test_v4_policy_catalogue_coverage.py
tests/test_predicate_fact_comparison.py
tests/test_predicate_hours_between.py
tests/test_policy_aware_recommendation_mapping.py
tests/test_v3_v4_result_isolation.py
definition_of_done: All eight v4 policies import into a fresh database.
Every v4 policy citation validates against the canonical transcript.
All ten cases have an exact v4 policy key.
The four regression cases produce the approved deterministic semantics in fixture-backed tests.
No v3 file or persisted v3 row changes.
The default rulebook remains v3 until Gate G4.

implementation_sequence.name: Harden SQLite persistence and recovery

mutable_application_databases: Enable WAL only through an explicit configure command after a verified backup.
Use synchronous=NORMAL when WAL is enabled.
historical_or_cached_databases: Do not enable WAL, migrate, checkpoint, vacuum, or alter pragmas that write.
connection_policy.verification: Immediately query PRAGMA foreign_keys after opening; raise a typed repository configuration error unless it equals 1.

backup_commands.implementation_rule: Use sqlite3.Connection.backup for a consistent backup. Emit a SHA-256 file and JSON manifest containing source path, created_at, integrity_check, foreign_key_check, schema version, and table counts.

baseline_database_reconciliation: Compare the working fixture-demo.db with the committed Git blob using schema hashes, ordered logical row exports, row counts, and per-table content hashes.
Compare data/live-validation.db with tracked databases using the same read-only report.
Do not include raw evidence text in the report.
Present the report for Gate G2.
If the fixture delta is accidental, restore it from HEAD only after approval.
If it contains unique intended results, export those results to a newly named checksum-labelled snapshot before restoring the historical baseline path.
Never overwrite the committed live-results checkpoint.
migration_rules: Apply each migration once in numeric order inside a transaction.
Record migration name, SHA-256, and applied_at.
Reject a migration whose stored hash differs from the current file.
Use foreign keys for every new child table.
Run PRAGMA integrity_check and PRAGMA foreign_key_check before and after migration.
Back up the mutable target before migration.
tests: Every repository connection reports foreign_keys=1.
An inserted orphan in a new child table is rejected.
A second writer waits for no more than the configured busy timeout and returns a typed busy error.
WAL configuration affects only the explicitly named mutable database.
A backup verifies and can be opened read-only with identical table counts and content hashes.
Migration replay is idempotent.
Migration hash drift fails closed.
Historical data/demo-validation.db retains its original checksum.
definition_of_done: All SQLite access uses the shared connection factory.
Declared foreign keys are enforced on every writable connection.
Mutable demo databases have a verified backup path.
Historical databases remain unchanged.
The two pre-existing worktree database exceptions have an approved disposition.

implementation_sequence.name: Persist bounded secret-safe failed-extraction diagnostics

new_domain_contract.name: AttemptFailureDiagnostic
fields: exception_type: controlled or sanitized class name
content_hash: sha256 of canonical diagnostic payload

database_table.name: demo_case_attempt_diagnostics
database_table.retention: Append-only; no raw provider response column.

sanitization_policy: Allowlist Pydantic field paths, error types, and messages.
For InvalidProviderResponseError, persist the already sanitized validation summary.
Refactor EvidenceCandidateValueError and provenance/citation exceptions to expose structured safe fields such as candidate path, fact name, document name, and page number.

Do not persist supporting_text, visual_observation, canonical page text, prompt bodies, response bodies, authorization headers, environment values, email content beyond already admitted structured facts, or filesystem paths outside the repository-relative evidence identity.
Redact bearer-token patterns, API-key patterns, URL user-info, and values matching configured secret environment variables.
Cap item count and length before persistence.
Hash the canonical sanitized payload and validate it on read.
ui_behaviour: A failed case shows the stage, exception type, and bounded diagnostic item list.
Use labels such as candidates.0.values.0.references.0 rather than a generic EvidenceCandidateValueError when safe details exist.
Never render a raw temporary provider-response artifact in Gradio.
Switching from a failed case to another case clears all previous diagnostic items.
A failed extraction remains FAILED and creates no FactResolutionResult, evaluation, recommendation, or review package.
tests: Diagnostics include candidate/fact/citation paths for known validation failures.
Secrets supplied through all MODEL_* variables never occur in diagnostic_json, logs, UI output, or exception repr.
Evidence text and raw provider response are absent.
More than 25 errors are truncated deterministically.
Tampered diagnostic JSON fails hash validation.
Invalid extraction still admits zero partial facts.
A failure in one batch case does not stop later cases.
definition_of_done: Failed cases are actionable without exposing secrets or raw evidence.
Fail-closed extraction behaviour is unchanged.
Historical failed attempts remain readable with their existing generic message.

implementation_sequence.name: Clarify analyst state and multi-attempt UI behaviour
implementation_sequence.visual_constraint: Preserve the current Gradio layout and analyst workflow; add only compact state, evidence-selection, history, and status presentation changes.

application_contract_changes.rule: Results are read from persistence and never trigger extraction.

specific_ui_changes: Display Machine package state separately from Latest analyst state.
Display the analyst decision action, decided_by, and decided_at when a decision exists.
Reject blank or placeholder analyst identities such as <analyst>, changeme, demo, or unknown. Require ANALYST_IDENTITY to be configured before a decision can be submitted.
Do not rewrite existing historical analyst identity values.
For a completed case, auto-select and render the first trusted evidence source. If no source exists but gaps do, select the first gap.
Rename Execution update to Last execution event.
Refresh Last execution event whenever the selected case changes; it must describe the selected case's latest attempt or state that no attempt exists.
Add a collapsed Attempt history table showing attempt number, execution mode, queued/started/completed timestamps, status, run ID, review-package availability, and safe failure type.
Use fixed, escaped status badge classes for NOT_RUN, QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, LIVE, and PERSISTED/CACHED.

When switching to failed or unprocessed cases, clear recommendation, rationale, requirements, facts, citations, evidence preview, page navigation, lineage, action controls, and diagnostics before rendering the new case state.
Never accept a browser-supplied filesystem path. Resolve evidence targets only from the validated persisted review package.
tests: Completed case A to completed case B shows only B's package, evidence, citations, and lineage.
Completed to failed clears all completed content and shows only the failed attempt.
Completed to NOT_RUN clears all persisted result content.
The first evidence target is selected automatically for a completed case.
Last execution event always names the selected case.
Attempt history is case-isolated and ordered newest first.
Machine package state does not change when an analyst decision is appended.
Effective analyst state reflects the latest immutable analyst decision.
Placeholder analyst identity cannot create a decision.
Cached package loading performs zero provider calls.
definition_of_done: No stale cross-case content is observable.
Machine and human workflow states are unambiguous.
Completed evidence is immediately inspectable.
Repeated attempts are visible without changing immutable history.
Recommendations remain explicitly advisory.

implementation_sequence.name: Record provider-neutral operational telemetry
capture_design: Create an in-memory ModelTelemetryCollector for each application attempt.
Pass the collector into create_extraction_runtime through a provider-neutral observer protocol.
Both document vision conversion and fact extraction report one record per external model request.
Measure latency with time.perf_counter_ns around the provider call.
For OpenAI-compatible chat completions, read prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, and total_tokens when returned.
For Responses-compatible calls, read input_tokens, output_tokens, and total_tokens when returned.
If usage is absent, persist null and display NOT REPORTED; never infer zero.
Persist failed-call telemetry with latency and safe exception type but no message or raw response.
Persist telemetry in the attempt database even when the case later fails.
Aggregate telemetry for TechnicalLineage without deleting individual request records.

cost_policy.calculation_rule: Calculate cost only when provider, model, token unit, currency, and effective date match an exact versioned local pricing manifest.
cost_policy.rounding: Decimal arithmetic with manifest-declared units and rounding.
cost_policy.prohibited: Do not scrape live prices during execution and do not guess a price.

security_rules: Do not store MODEL_API_KEY or any environment value.
Do not store request headers, endpoints containing credentials, prompt text, evidence text, or raw responses.
Provider and model identifiers are allowed.
Hash and validate every telemetry record.
ui_changes: Replace NOT RECORDED with actual totals when records exist.
Display NOT REPORTED for missing provider usage.
Display NOT CONFIGURED for unavailable pricing.
Show provider, model, adapter, prompt version, schema version, request count, latency, tokens, and cost status in collapsed Technical lineage.
Label telemetry as PERSISTED when reopening a cached result.
tests: Successful fake provider calls record latency and model identity.
Chat-completions and Responses usage shapes map correctly.
Missing usage remains null.
Failed calls persist safe telemetry without secret or evidence content.
Multiple model calls aggregate without losing per-request records.
Exact pricing manifests calculate deterministic Decimal costs.
Missing pricing displays NOT CONFIGURED.
Cached view loading makes no new telemetry records.
Telemetry from one case never appears in another case.
definition_of_done: Every new live request has immutable provider/model/latency telemetry.
Token and cost fields are honest about unavailable data.
Technical lineage uses persisted records.
No credentials or raw evidence are persisted.

implementation_sequence.name: Integrated validation and controlled rollout

validation_order.expectation: All prior tests plus new tests pass; ordinary tests make zero live-provider calls.
All ten cases create isolated immutable lineages; policy-sensitive expected outcomes are asserted from approved source semantics.

validation_order.target: A copy created with sqlite3.Connection.backup, never data/demo-validation.db.
validation_order.expectation: Integrity, foreign keys, content hashes, and cached package reads survive.
Case switching, failure diagnostics, evidence auto-selection, analyst state, attempt history, and cached loading work without callback errors.

validation_order.rule: Start with one new validation database and one case; do not mutate historical checkpoints.

rollout: Create a new mutable database for v4 validation.
Import take-home-v4 and mapping manifest v2.
Run one policy-sensitive case with fixtures and inspect the complete persisted lineage.
After Gate G3, run one explicitly approved live case.
Run all ten cases with failure isolation only after the single case succeeds.
Keep v3 and v4 results visible as distinct attempts with rulebook labels.
Change the default version only after Gate G4.
rollback: Continue opening the committed v3 database read-only.
Do not delete v4 attempts; label them failed or experimental and preserve their immutable lineage.
Restore a mutable database only from a verified backup into a new path.
Never roll back by rewriting historical rows.
definition_of_done: All automated tests pass.
All four policy defects have direct regression tests.
v3 hashes and the historical database checksum are unchanged.
SQLite safeguards are active on mutable connections.
Failed cases show useful secret-safe diagnostics.
UI state is case-isolated and distinguishes machine, analyst, live, cached, and failure state.
New live calls record honest telemetry.
No live run or default-version promotion occurs without its approval gate.

acceptance_matrix.required_result: No automatic defect-free conclusion; R2 follows approved alternative comparison branches; R3 follows alternative return/use branches; missing return request remains insufficient.
Delivery address matching frozen shipping postcode is not defeated by a billing-postcode mismatch.
Exact NO-SHOW is recognized; late cancellation uses timezone-aware deterministic arithmetic when all inputs exist.
The default accept-liability outcome maps to RECOMMEND_DO_NOT_REPRESENT unless the miscoding exception is affirmatively established.

risk_register.risk: Visa 13.3 source language may not define when one illustrative comparison branch is sufficient.
risk_register.mitigation: Gate G1; do not invent materiality or promote v4 when source semantics remain ambiguous.

risk_register.risk: New DATETIME facts for Mastercard 4859 may not be present in supplied evidence.
risk_register.mitigation: Return UNKNOWN for the late-cancellation branch; allow the independently sufficient NO-SHOW branch to operate.

risk_register.risk: Enabling WAL or applying migrations to a valuable historical database changes it.
risk_register.mitigation: Historical databases are read-only. Rehearse against backup-created copies and use new mutable v4 databases.

risk_register.risk: Detailed extraction errors leak evidence or secrets.
risk_register.mitigation: Structured allowlist, bounded fields, secret redaction, content exclusions, and explicit security tests.

risk_register.risk: Provider usage fields differ across adapters.
risk_register.mitigation: Adapter-specific parsing into one provider-neutral contract; absent fields remain null.

risk_register.risk: UI additions reintroduce stale cross-case content.
risk_register.mitigation: One application view model, comprehensive clear-state outputs, and completed-to-failed-to-not-run browser tests.

deliverables: Immutable v3 checksum manifest and checkpoint audit.
Executable, cited, versioned take-home-v4 rulebook with all eight policy keys.
Shared SQLite connection and migration infrastructure.
Verified database backup and integrity commands.
Append-only safe diagnostics and model telemetry tables.
Existing Gradio UI enhanced with accurate state, evidence defaulting, attempt history, diagnostics, and telemetry.
Complete automated regression suite and gated live-validation instructions.
Final report separating code existence, automated proof, fixture proof, live proof, and unverified behaviour.
final_definition_of_done: No historical v3 policy or result changed.
The committed v3 live-results database retains its exact checksum.
The four materially misleading behaviours are corrected only in take-home-v4 and are covered by deterministic tests.
All ten supplied cases have exact v4 policy coverage and registered facts.
All repositories enforce declared foreign keys.
Mutable demo databases have tested backup and bounded-concurrency configuration.
Failed extractions remain fail-closed and produce bounded secret-safe diagnostics.
The UI cannot display stale state from another case and clearly distinguishes package, analyst, live, cached, failed, and attempt state.
Provider identity and latency are always recorded for new live calls; tokens and cost are shown only when actually available.
The full non-live test suite passes.
Live execution and changing the default rulebook remain separate approval decisions.
